usedFor: AnnounceKit publishes product updates, and Google Drive turns a file into a link through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new post is created” in AnnounceKit, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new post can come with a shareable link to a chosen file, set to Viewer, Commenter or Editor.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens the file to everyone holding the link, so check the access level you set.
